description: Use work AI subscriptions alongside personal accounts and see shared JetBrains Central credits in BB. JetBrains Air is JetBrains' platform for coding agents and team AI access; this plugin connects BB through JetBrains Central CLI using your JetBrains Account. Choose separate Codex, Claude Code, and Pi providers, or configure additional ACP profiles. Requires BB 0.48+ with Plugin SDK 0.6.104+, Git, Node.js, Central with a work subscription or organization-provided AI access, and the corresponding agent CLIs; tested on macOS.
